subject: Risk & Compliance
title: AI and Autonomous Risk
description: Learn AI and Autonomous Risk in one minute.

hook.text: An AI system makes a trading decision that triggers a flash crash. No human was involved. Who's responsible?

buildup.text: AI creates new global risks: autonomous weapons, deepfake misinformation, algorithmic bias, and uncontrollable systems.

discovery.text: The EU AI Act classifies AI by risk level and bans uses like social scoring and real-time biometric surveillance.

twist.text: AI development outpaces regulation. By the time rules exist, the technology has already moved beyond them.

climax.text: AI is the fastest-moving global risk. Managing it requires international cooperation that doesn't yet exist.

punchline.text: AI decides. Flash crash happens. No human involved. Who pays?

quiz.question: What does the EU AI Act do?
options: Classifies AI by risk level and bans certain high-risk uses
Bans all AI development in Europe
